subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about pay-per-validated-booking web acquisition. One timely reason it matters now: OTAs still held 60.72% of the North America online travel market in 2025, but direct supplier channels are growing at an 8.97% CAGR, so suppliers are paying to win bookings they used to get for free. With travel CPA running $49.20 on search to $112.80 on display, every wasted click compounds against thin take rates. We hold out a control group so the paid bookings show as incremental. Worth comparing against your current channel mix?
angle: fresh angle: 2025 OTA-vs-direct-channel shift (sourced) + travel CPA band $49.20-$112.80
register_notes: Stage 2 EN travel_and_booking CPS: references prior email in first sentence; fresh angle = timely development (OTA 60.72% share 2025 + direct channels 8.97% CAGR, mordorintelligence) anchored to travel CPA band $49.20 search to $112.80 display (amraandelma); both source URLs retrieved and confirmed; market context only, never attributed to MobUpps; MobUpps holdout reference carries no figure; 1 question mark; native register; no sign-off; no X-not-Y.
